description: Run OpenVibe.Vision's UI check: POST /api/v1/ui-check takes HTML, a public URL or a screenshot plus an optional viewport and returns overflow, cut-off text, low contrast, overlap and layering findings with counts and severity; GET /api/v1/ui-checks/:id reads a saved check. OpenVibe.Design's Arena is the caller today; a signed-in person may also use it. The check runs entirely on Vision's host (static HTML/CSS parsing, or OCR boxes and pixel sampling for a screenshot): it executes no JavaScript and fetches only a public URL through the SSRF guard.
